subject: Operations
title: Total Cost of Ownership
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Total Cost of Ownership.

hook.text: A printer costs $50. Ink cartridges over its life cost $500. The $50 price tag hides the real cost.

buildup.text: TCO adds up every cost: purchase price, shipping, quality inspection, rework, storage, and disposal.

discovery.text: Purchase price is often only 25–50% of total cost. The rest hides in operations, maintenance, and logistics.

twist.text: A $10 part from overseas may cost $18 after shipping, tariffs, quality checks, and longer lead times.

climax.text: Companies using TCO analysis routinely find that their cheapest supplier is actually their most expensive.

punchline.text: Price is what you pay. Cost is what you spend.

quiz.question: What does TCO include beyond purchase price?
options: All lifecycle costs including storage and disposal
